unit-converter.title: Unit Converter & Plot Area Calculator | Marla, Kanal, Sq Ft, Gaz | Mufeed Tools
unit-converter.description: Convert centimetres to feet and inches, and work out plot area in square feet, square yards, marla and kanal. Includes a unit reference table. Free.
unit-converter.h1: Unit Converter and Plot Area Calculator (Marla, Kanal)
unit-converter.lead: Convert a length from one unit to another, and work out a plot's area in marla, kanal, square feet and square yards from its four walls.
unit-converter.convDesc: Choose a unit and type a value; the result appears in every other unit at once.
unit-converter.plotDesc: Enter the length of the four walls in feet and inches.
unit-converter.plotNote: The calculation uses the average of each pair of opposite walls. What is left after the marlas is shown in square feet and square inches (1 sq ft = 144 sq in). For irregular plots the result is approximate.
unit-converter.marlaTitle: How many square feet is a marla?
unit-converter.marlaText: This tool uses 225 sq ft (25 sq yd) for a marla. In some areas and housing schemes 250 or 272.25 sq ft (30.25 sq yd) is used instead, so check the standard where you are before buying or selling a plot, and choose it from the list above.

faq.q: How many square feet is one marla?
faq.a: Usually 225 sq ft (25 sq yd), though some areas and schemes use 250 or 272.25 sq ft. Choose the right standard in the tool.

faq.q: How many marla are in a kanal?
faq.a: One kanal equals 20 marla. On the 225 standard that is 4,500 sq ft, and on the 272.25 standard it is 5,445 sq ft.

faq.q: How do I convert centimetres to feet and inches?
faq.a: Choose centimetre as the unit and type the value. For example, 182 cm is about 5 ft 11.65 in.

faq.q: How is the area of an irregular plot worked out?
faq.a: The tool averages each pair of opposite walls to get a length and a width. It gives an estimate; for legal matters rely on a licensed surveyor.

faq.q: How is my zodiac sign worked out?
faq.a: Your sign depends on your date of birth. The year is divided into twelve parts, each with a sign. Check your date in the table above, or enter it in the tool.
The tool picks from ready-written playful lines using a simple rule based on the length of your name and your date. There is no astronomical calculation, so do not take it as true.
